name: Strawberry Spoon Cake

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Place 3 tablespoons melted butter in a 23-cm round cake pan and tilt pan to ensure bottom is evenly covered with butter.
In a medium bowl, toss strawberries with lime juice, 1/2 cup sugar, and 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt until combined. Set aside to macerate while preparing batter, about 10 minutes.

In a large bowl, whisk to combine flour, baking powder, cardamom, lime zest, remaining 3/4 cup sugar, and remaining 3/4 teaspoon salt. Slowly pour milk and remaining 3 tablespoons melted butter into flour mixture and whisk to combine (batter will be thick).
Spoon batter over melted butter in cake pan. Spoon strawberries and any accumulated juices evenly over top of cake. Pour hot water evenly over strawberries; do not stir.
Bake until golden brown and a warm pudding-like sauce forms below the strawberries and is bubbling up the sides, about 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: Strawberry Spoon Cake, strawberry cake recipe

description: This easy strawberry spoon cake transforms fresh summer berries into a warm, jammy dessert with a golden cake top and custardy cake layer—all in under an hour.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, for serving

Make-ahead and storage: The cake is best eaten warm right after baking, but leftover cake can be refrigerated for up to 2 days. Reheat in a 175°C (350°F) oven until warm through, about 10 minutes.
author: Leah Colins
